Bicolor Cat - rebuilt and animated by kenchoo
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bicolor-cat-e623a618ca344a8393d7ba4d63ec23cf
Based on "3d modelling my cat: Fripouille" by guillaume bolis: https://skfb.ly/6TKqH
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: FBX/material conversion; topology, albedo, eyes and rig retained; UV2 normals baked to 1K UV0; authored idle/sniff/four-beat in-place walk clips replace original clip; whiskers bound to head.
The public GLB mirror is code4fukui/vr-cats; its MIT code licence does not replace this asset licence.
